searches.reason: Validate the diagnostic toolkit itself through controlled fault injection: incorrect left-padding readout, future-token leakage, broken item mapping, and scorer mismatch. Measure probe detection sensitivity and false alarms alongside harmless transformations. Use disposable diagnostic copies of the single fitted model; no additional predictor enters inference. This establishes whether probes detect known defects before using them to motivate costly training changes.
